Select the smallest applicable capabilities and conditional branches; omit non-applicable stages with reasons.
Construct typed handoffs, authority transitions, feedback edges, and evidence invalidation rules.
Advance only on machine and human gates; stop on incompatible permissions or stale evidence.
Emit workflow state and next action without executing any selected capability.
designs.trigger: Select and sequence atomic capabilities, preserve state and artifact identities, enforce gates, and route feedback without performing downstream work.
triggers: Build a conditional capability workflow for this product task from the approved atomic contracts.
Resume this lifecycle run from its saved stage and invalidate stale downstream evidence.
